The writ petition
has been filed for the following relief(s) "For issuance of an appropriate writ(s)/order(s) and / or
direction (s) for quashing the order dated 30.06.2017 (Annexure-3) passed by the Deputy
Commissioner cum Adjudicating Officer, Ranchi, by which accused namely Shri Abhijeet Ghosh, son
of Shri Arun Ghosh, Prop. Of M/s Abhijeet Sweet, A.G. Colony, Ranchi, from whom the sample of
khoya purchased from the accused Abhijeet Ghosh was found below the prescribed limit of
variability, hence, the accused has committed an offence punishable under Section 3(1)(2x), 26, 27
and 51 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006."

2.  It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that there is alternative and efficacious remedy available under the said Act and now the Tribunal is functional and as such, he seeks permission to withdraw the writ petition.
3. Learned counsel for the other side has no objection to the prayer.
